title: Allied foo fighter investigations with Robertson and Alvarez

tellings.quote: And one of the people that was uh assigned to conduct that study happened to be Dr. Howard Robertson from Caltech

plain: A former US Senate staffer named Kurt McConnell, speaking on Jesse Michels's podcast in 2025, says that during the Second World War, around 1942 to 1945, the Allies studied the "foo fighters", the strange lights their pilots reported over Europe and the Pacific. He says one of the scientists assigned to the study was Dr. Howard Robertson of Caltech, a top science university, alongside a scientist named Luis Alvarez. To him, this shows serious scientists were looking at these sightings long before UFOs became a public topic.
